import json
from pathlib import Path
import numpy as np
from skfem import MeshTri, Basis, ElementTriP1, asm, condense, solve
from skfem.models.poisson import laplace, unit_load
m = MeshTri().refined(3)
b = Basis(m, ElementTriP1())
u = solve(*condense(asm(laplace,b), asm(unit_load,b), D=b.get_dofs()))
p = Path('/workspace/qualification/oasis')
p.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
(p/'poisson-readiness.json').write_text(json.dumps({'solver':'scikit-fem','nodes':int(b.N),'maximum':float(u.max()),'all_finite':bool(np.isfinite(u).all()),'critic_approved':False}))
print('Actual Poisson probe:',b.N,float(u.max()))
